improvements.rationale: A clear meta description under 160 characters improves click-through rates from search results by communicating the core value proposition and free trial offer. Open Graph tags ensure professional, consistent previews when the homepage is shared on LinkedIn, Facebook, or messaging apps—critical for a B2B audience. Including the free searches hook in both creates urgency without overpromising.

improvements.suggestion:
Hero Headline: "Your AI-Powered Trade & Business Assistant"

Subheading: "Meet Gideon — get instant answers, voice chat support, and a dedicated workspace for your business. Try 3 free searches today."
improvements.rationale: The headline immediately communicates what Gideon is (AI assistant) and who it's for (trade and business). The subheading reinforces key value props (instant answers, voice chat, workspace) while creating a clear, low-friction call to action with the free trial offer. The word 'Meet' personalizes the AI and aligns with the Gideon branding.

improvements.suggestion:
Q: What happens after my three free searches?

A: Once you've used your three complimentary searches with Gideon, you'll be invited to become a member to continue. Membership starts from just US$2 per day, giving you unlimited access to Gideon's AI-powered trade and business support, voice chat, and your own members workspace. Choose annual billing to save 30 percent.
improvements.rationale: This FAQ directly addresses the most common friction point in the conversion funnel—what happens at the paywall. By clearly explaining the transition from free to paid, stating the low entry price, and highlighting the annual savings, it reduces uncertainty and encourages sign-up. It uses only verified pricing from the site context.
